paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between prompt depth and accuracy, expressed as a percentage. The x-axis, labeled “Prompt Depth (J)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, also employs a linear scale, ranging from approximately 74% to 81%, with tick labels spaced at 1% intervals. A dashed orange line, representing “mmssd”, begins at approximately 80% and decreases to approximately 74% over the course of the x-axis. A solid blue line, representing “mmssd2”, starts at approximately 74% and declines to approximately 77% over the x-axis.
